environment.notes: Local Windows fixtures and isolated profiles. Checks may share host CPU; no physical phone or media decoder acceptance.

performanceSourceDifference.detail: Full library performance completed before the last failure-path edit. cancel now sends sanitized failure.status instead of error.status || failure.status. Final JSON/socket, server lifecycle, transcode interests, plugins and bridge checks were rerun after that edit.

limits.scope: Budgets cover admitted encoded input/output buffers; they do not bound all business objects, temporary contract/stringify heap, OS socket buffers or process RSS.

compressionAndLegacy.conditions: Node production compressor/transport with controlled completing writable; prebuilt JSON excludes schema validation/serialization and network. Legacy equivalence separately uses actual HTTP and schema.
compressionAndLegacy.interpretation: One sample of eight prebuilt JSON compressions. Synchronous baseline uses real gzipSync only in verifier; production sample uses bounded async service, UTF-8 buffers and a controlled completing writable. Separate legacy HTTP checks use real production contract validation and 10000 generated DTOs. Timings are not throughput or decoder results.

libraryInterpretation.fixture: 5000/10000 real local files containing only 24-byte MP4 headers; real production scanner/settings/HTTP. No media decoding.
libraryInterpretation.desktop: Actual production React/preload/main in hidden Electron; first 100 cards and interactive search under progressive scan. Each scored sample had indexed a prefix of 131 files when first interactive; not a full-library cold-scan completion metric.
libraryInterpretation.samples: One separately reported warmup plus three scored starts. Verifier P95 of three starts is their maximum, not a long-run percentile.
libraryInterpretation.largerColdWork: coldScanMs and hotIndexedFirstPageMs are separate measurements and remain multiple seconds; neither is represented by the progressive desktop first-page timing.

authorizationSemantics.capture: Directory signature established at first JSON preparation, preserving a library snapshot rebuilt after a policy change.
authorizationSemantics.headers: Actual credential file reread before headers; isolated direct edit without app notification is tested.
authorizationSemantics.continuation: App authorization generation plus current policy signature checked between output chunks. Stable transmission avoids per-chunk credential-file reads. External credential edits after headers without app notifications are not guaranteed to interrupt an already-started response.
authorizationSemantics.commits: Accepted own-unpair may acknowledge its intentional revocation. Sent bytes cannot be recalled; completed mutations are not rolled back on response failure.
